presentation.description:
Allows you to upload local images and step through them as a slideshow

/slideshow or /slide toggles the slide viewer window
/slideshow add opens a file picker to upload slides
/slideshow folder opens the local slides folder on your computer
/slideshow next moves to the next slide
/slideshow prev moves to the previous slide
/slideshow reload reloads all images from the slides folder
/slideshow clear clears all loaded slides
presentation.summary: Upload and view local images as slides.
